runs.question: What is the grace period for a failed renewal payment?

passage.title: Billing and invoicing
passage.heading: Failed payments
passage.text: A failed renewal payment starts a seven-day grace period. The billing service retries on days two and five. At the end of the grace period, editors lose write access until the payment clears.

citations.quote: A failed renewal payment starts a seven-day grace period.

passage.title: Refunds and credits
passage.heading: Annual subscription cancellations
passage.text: An annual subscription may be refunded within fourteen calendar days of the initial purchase. Renewals are excluded from this refund window. Finance normally processes an approved refund within five business days.

passage.text: Maintenance notifications are sent by email and posted on the status page at least forty-eight hours in advance. The message gives the affected region and estimated maintenance period.

runs.question: For an ongoing outage, compare the critical ticket response target and the status update cadence.

passage.title: Support coverage
passage.heading: First response
passage.text: An Enterprise ticket marked critical has a one-hour initial response target. The response target measures the first human acknowledgement and is independent of incident status update cadence.

passage.heading: Long-term storage
passage.text: Aggregated usage counters that contain no workspace identifiers may persist for twelve months. Encrypted recovery copies expire according to the backup retention policy.

passage.heading: Trial duration
passage.text: A trial workspace lasts twenty-one days. No credit card is required to start the trial. The workspace becomes read-only when the trial ends.

passage.heading: Ownership handover
passage.text: Ownership can be transferred only to an existing administrator. The current owner confirms the handover through a one-time verification code and becomes an administrator.
